name: io.github.kzavrazhnyi/mcbp-ai
title: BAS / 1C (MCBP+)
description: Read BAS/1C catalogs, documents, registers and metadata. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the BAS publication, up to the service name: http(s)://<host>/<base>/hs/mcbp_ai (without the /ai/v1 suffix — the client appends it)

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_USER
environmentVariables.description: HTTP Basic user of the BAS publication

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the BAS user. May be an empty string (some demo bases have no password), but the variable itself must be set

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_POOL_MAX
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of pooled HTTP connections

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify the TLS certificate; set to 0 for self-signed intranet publications

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also register the three write tools (write_object, patch_object, save_context). Off by default — the server is read-only unless this is enabled
